card.name: Nouns in fiction plot summaries
card.fires_on: A noun or verb landing in a narrative plot summary of a novel, opera, or show, often right after 'the' or 'her'. Examples are Ministry, meeting, letter, room, company.

modes.label: Noun after the/her
modes.description: A story noun right after 'the' or 'her' in a plot retelling.
modes.example: Francisca thinks the<< letter>> contains merely excuses for his abrupt departure.

modes.label: Story event or action
modes.description: A meeting, arrival, or decision verb in a character-driven summary.
modes.example: Claudio and Clara are surprised during a secret<< meeting>> by Martino and Ines.

modes.label: Inside a title
modes.description: Partway through a named episode or work title.

card.plain: It fires on key nouns in retellings of fictional plots, such as operas, novels and TV episodes.
